name: Newt Gingrich
subject: Be not afraid
body:
They need our prayers & our voice
| | | | |
---
Friend,
I want to take you back in history for a moment, and you’ll very quickly understand why.

Forty-seven years ago, in the shadow of Soviet tanks and communist oppression, Pope John Paul II stepped onto Polish soil for the first time in thirty-one years and spoke three simple words:

_**“Be not afraid.”**_

Millions had gathered there in Warsaw’s Victory Square. The regime trembled. And within a decade, the Berlin Wall lay in rubble.

**Paired together with courageous political leadership from Ronald Reagan and Margaret Thatcher,_faith – spoken boldly – had triumphed over fear._**

Today, that same spirit is under siege – not in Poland, but in places like **Nigeria, Sudan and even South Korea.**

**Consider Leah Sharibu, a brave 15-year-old Christian schoolgirl in Nigeria.** In 2018, Islamic State barbarians abducted 110 girls from her school. While 104 were returned and five tragically killed, they kept Leah – as punishment for her **unyielding refusal to renounce Christ and convert to Islam.** Now, many years later, she remains in captivity with ISWAP (Islamic State West Africa Province), who threaten to hold her as a "slave for life."

And yet, this is just one example facing Christians in Nigeria. Since 2009, there have been a reported **19,000 churches destroyed** , **over 100,000 killed** and **at least 5 million more displaced.** The data reveal that for every one Muslim, 5.2 Christians are killed.

**In Sudan** , Islamist paramilitaries known as the Rapid Support Forces have been on a rampage, **bombing churches** , and **killing priests and worshippers sheltering inside while forcing survivors to convert or be killed** – in some cases, **_crucified_**. **Over 150,000 have died in the conflict, many hunted and targeted for their faith.** This ongoing conflict has resulted in a catastrophic humanitarian crisis, including mass displacement, severe food insecurity, and the complete collapse of public services.

**In South Korea** , a nation we rebuilt and have defended for 75 years, the new government with communist sympathies has been **arresting pastors, seizing church records, and even jailed an 82-year-old religious leader for leading prayer.**

name: Nancy Dahlstrom
subject: There are three common themes this election.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nancy Dahlstrom For Governor P
body:
I'd like to discuss them with you.| | | __Click here if you wish to unsubscribe__
---
Dear Peter, I've heard a lot of things from voters across the state, but there are a few common themes that keep popping up, and I'd like to discuss them with you. _**Affordability.**_ Affordable living, safe neighborhoods, and good schools are key to our future. I want every family to be able to live without fear of cutting back on groceries or essentials due to astronomical prices and high energy costs. _**Public Safety.**_** ** Especially in our larger urban areas, voters are worried. As a former Commissioner of Corrections, I worked directly with law enforcement to fight crime and saw the real consequences of weak policies. We must put victims before criminals and stand with those who serve. _**The PFD.**_ This dividend is the right of every single Alaskan, and you deserve clarity and transparency in the process. Right now, politicians decide everything. I think it's time to change that. We have a lot of work to do, and I hope to be your next governor so we may get started on **_day one_**. My promise to you is the same one I made when I started my career in public service 23 years ago: People over politics. _Always._
---
Sincerely,
**Nancy Dahlstrom
** _Alaska's Lt. Governor, Law Enforcement Leader, and_ _2026 Republican Candidate for Governor_ _
_

clean_body: I'd like to discuss them with you.| | | Click here if you wish to unsubscribe Dear Peter, I've heard a lot of things from voters across the state, but there are a few common themes that keep popping up, and I'd like to discuss them with you. Affordability. Affordable living, safe neighborhoods, and good schools are key to our future. I want every family to be able to live without fear of cutting back on groceries or essentials due to astronomical prices and high energy costs. Public Safety. Especially in our larger urban areas, voters are worried. As a former Commissioner of Corrections, I worked directly with law enforcement to fight crime and saw the real consequences of weak policies. We must put victims before criminals and stand with those who serve. The PFD. This dividend is the right of every single Alaskan, and you deserve clarity and transparency in the process. Right now, politicians decide everything. I think it's time to change that. We have a lot of work to do, and I hope to be your next governor so we may get started on day one. My promise to you is the same one I made when I started my career in public service 23 years ago: People over politics. Always. Sincerely, Nancy Dahlstrom Alaska's Lt. Governor, Law Enforcement Leader, and 2026 Republican Candidate for Governor P.S. body:
ICE raided 15 Zipps locations and arrested 35+ workers. This is Trump's deportation agenda in action — and it's coming for Arizona. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124727812/599511369/-1397648958?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260204_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZThkMmUwZTMtZmMwMS1mMTExLTgzMmYtMDAwZDNhMWYwZTRjIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=gRJ6gBnBvaRvjYUTfqSLbkqr4A78_KNtyv4Jwd-wKEk=)
---
Hi there — Federal immigration agents raided 15 Zipps Sports Grill locations across the Phoenix area last week, arresting more than 35 workers. This is the reality of Trump's immigration enforcement: workplace raids, mass arrests, families torn apart, and communities terrorized. Senator Ruben Gallego warned this was coming. He told Arizonans that ICE isn't going after criminals — they're engaging in racial profiling to intimidate local populations. He warned that ICE isn't afraid to detain U.S. citizens for as long as they can. **Now we're seeing it play out across Arizona.** While Republicans push legislation to criminalize protesting ICE and defend lawless agents, Democrats are demanding accountability and standing with Arizona communities facing federal overreach. All six Arizona Republican House members — Andy Biggs, Juan Ciscomani, Eli Crane, Paul Gosar, Abe Hamadeh, and David Schweikert — voted for the DHS funding bill that enables this enforcement. I take those responsibilities seriously – and that’s why I owe it to you to be honest about what’s at stake.

Republicans, backed by Donald Trump, are pushing a dangerous agenda that threatens reproductive rights, access to affordable healthcare, and democracy itself.

Peter,

In less than two weeks, millions of people will gather to watch the biggest football game of the year. **Bright lights.**
**Packed hotels.** **Most people don't know this...** Wherever crowds gather, traffickers follow. Major sporting weekends bring increased travel, full hotels, busy airports, and distracted attention. **Behind the excitement ...**
**Children will go missing.** This is the perfect environment for exploitation. Law enforcement and child protection organizations know this pattern well. **Trafficking spikes around large events because vulnerability increases. **While millions are preparing for entertainment, vulnerable children are facing danger. They're not thinking about scores or highlights, but hoping to be safe - waiting for help before harm happens. This is why this moment matters. Here is a truth that should stop us cold: **9 out of 10 missing children are trafficked right here in the United States.** That's why I'm reaching out to you today. The**Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists to interrupt these moments of danger with protection, prevention, and action. We are not here for awareness alone.Awareness without action does not save a child. We are here to stop trafficking before it starts, support intervention efforts, and protect children when the risk is highest. **But this mission is not an idea. ****It is personal. **
**It is lived. **
**It is carried by those who know danger firsthand.**

My name is Theresa Flores. I'm a survivor of child trafficking. And today, I work to help protect children **before they disappear.** **I was fifteen years old. **
**An honor student. **
**A daughter. ** A girl who trusted the wrong "friend." **I was trafficked for two years.**

Most people imagine trafficking happens far away...in dark alleys...in other countries.

To "other people." **But that's not how it usually happens.** Right now, as set up for the big game is underway, **120 trained partner volunteers are already on the ground in the Bay Area**. Men and women working _this week_ --
Training hotel staff to recognize danger. Walking hotel halls, parking garages and public spaces. **Watching.**
**Reporting.**
**Protecting.** **Standing where traffickers don't expect resistance.** Children cannot choose safety on their own. They depend on adults to act when danger is highest. Freedom is not a word painted in an end zone. It's safety, dignity and the chance to grow up without fear. Your donation right now helps fund prevention programs, strengthen intervention efforts, and protect innocent lives from trafficking and abuse.It turns high-risk moments into moments of defense and hope.

Hi there, Team Molder here — we are so excited to be launching our campaign newsletter! First, we wanted to introduce ourselves! We are Jasmine and Sam, and we recently joined the team as Campaign Manager and Political Director. See more about us below: **Jasmine Singh** will be serving as **Campaign Manager**. Originally from Houston, Jasmine has worked in campaign management, political fundraising, and voter outreach across the South, including in Texas, Virginia, Alabama, and now Tennessee. **Sam Williams** will be serving as **Political Director**. A Nashville native, Sam previously worked as an attorney and has experience with political fundraising and voter outreach in local and national politics before returning home to serve in this senior role. We have enjoyed meeting so many of you and look forward to meeting those we haven’t yet on the trail! We intend to use this newsletter as a space to update you all on what is happening in Team Molder world. Here are some exciting updates from January. **Fundraising
** Campaign finance reports came out this past weekend, and we wanted to share a few takeaways.
1. With the help of all of you, we have officially raised over $1.2 million since entering the race, 92% of which coming from Tennesseans.
2. Chaz is leading the charge! He raised more in Q4 than all other candidates running for Tennessee’s Fifth Congressional District.
3. We are significantly outpacing all candidates including Republican incumbent Andy Ogles, where we hold a 15-to-1 cash on hand advantage going into the new year.

**Race Ratings Changes
** Earlier this month, the Cook Political Report shifted their predictions for this district in our favor! This is another sign that the momentum is behind us and that Middle Tennessee is ready for new leadership focused on what matters. **[Check out our press release for more details.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/LCLy9_jn9gLX549k6YQvxw~~/AAUS1hA~/0mI3l_6kUHIaNRL50JCZ3y6xKcrx_jrGpehQ6VosK6ynj5Wm4QME_R7pE2ZrL9gb-kGa9zI2EjwBwBl0j4_UmBgM9QDEYw-x2a-X1a6620u9pitOA3AEk3mDwngkmgAFTtSFccmENSwAPkyU10KkznYaxLU2TlZG0EgI0uHFjPn_2zXExVIq64a7pSFLEwJf) ** **Traveling the 5th

MLK Day Events Chaz and his daughter attended the Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Fellowship Reception, hosted by Spencer Fane, at the National Museum of African American Music in Nashville. **" Thousands of Texas Public School Students Participated in Anti-ICE Protests During School Hours"** [The Texan's](https://substack.com/redirect/7917fa9e-1569-42b7-ba22-ac633682e1bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **Meridith Dyer** - Thousands of Texas public school students participated in protests against U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement's (ICE) actions across the country on Friday, January 30.

**Austin Independent School District (ISD)** students protesting alongside school officials and Austin ISD police officers sparked online backlash from elected officials.

(_[THE TEXAN](https://substack.com/redirect/d52cd75e-0c6e-49e1-89c2-b3f89549b4b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_)

**" After El Paso's Medical Examiner ruled migrant's death a homicide, ICE sent the next body to an Army hospital"** [Texas Tribune's](https://substack.com/redirect/fe3b61a8-4044-40a2-bd77-362025f08dc7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **Colleen DeGuzman** - The body of a migrant who died at an El Paso immigration detention center was sent to a military hospital rather than the county medical examiner who investigated two previous deaths at the facility -- and concluded that one of them was a homicide rather than a suicide. **Victor Manuel Diaz** , a 36-year-old Nicaraguan, died Jan. 14 at Camp East Montana, a massive tent facility the federal government built on the Fort Bliss Army base. According to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, Diaz was found unconscious and unresponsive in his room and died of "a presumed suicide."

Diaz's autopsy is being performed at the William Beaumont Army Medical Center in Fort Bliss, which doesn't release autopsy reports to the public -- only to family members and investigators, according to Jessia Rovero, a public affairs officer at Fort Bliss.

This comes after the El Paso Medical Examiner recently ruled a previous detainee's death a homicide, contradicting ICE's contention that he died by suicide.

(_[TX TRIB](https://substack.com/redirect/9ec7b641-94c3-4b3a-8ba5-421a8ec3d929?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_)

[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/bb88e542-21e5-4087-b119-fd61658c7d27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**" Dallas has worst fatal car crash rate among large cities, study finds"** via [Dallas Morning News](https://substack.com/redirect/eb349dfc-6fc2-4bd5-8dc2-23aa0ec07559?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - Dallas saw an average of nearly 14 fatal motor vehicle crashes annually per every 100,000 residents between 2014 and 2023, according to a recent analysis.

In a joint study released last week, Drafahl Law Firm, a St. Louis-based personal injury firm, and 1Point21, a San Diego-based marketing agency, found that the fatal crash rate was the highest among large American cities.

The grim data point also backs up a long-held perception that driving around Dallas is generally unpleasant -- both because of the area's bad roads, high traffic congestion, and a large contingent of motorists known for aggressive driving.

At the time, a report from **Forbes Advisor** concluded that Dallas was tied with Atlanta as the American city where "you're most likely to get into a car accident," with Dallas drivers 46% more likely to be involved in a wreck than drivers in other parts of the country.

A 2024 report from Forbes placed Dallas 6th on its "worst drivers" list, and Fort Worth in 9th place.

(_[DMN](https://substack.com/redirect/f62f8ffd-f5bf-415f-89b7-6c4b467e75a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_)
* * *
* **LOCAL GOVERNMENT**

**" DART officials review withdrawal city proposals as special election approaches"** [Community Impact Newspaper's](https://substack.com/redirect/58dce747-8016-44be-9c19-daf0b9ccbae9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **Jacquelyn Burrer** - DART officials review withdrawal city proposals as special election approaches
With several cities now considering withdrawal elections, DART and city officials are discussing city proposals that could lead cities to cancel their upcoming elections.

At their Jan. 27 meeting, DART officials reviewed proposals from Plano and other cities as part of ongoing talks over service levels, funding and governance. **Plano officials** have submitted two agreements that could lead the city to cancel its upcoming special election.

Since Plano City Council voted to call the special election, nearly half of DART's 13 member cities have now scheduled withdrawal elections, including Highland Park, University Park, Irving, Farmers Branch and Addison.

Since calling the special election in November, Plano officials have submitted two formal proposals to DART that could lead the city to rescinding its withdrawal election if agreed upon.

Irving and Farmers Branch have also submitted written proposals to DART that are currently being evaluated. Carrollton, despite not calling a withdrawal election, submitted proposed changes to DART's general mobility program interlocal agreement.

(_[COMMUNITY IMPACT](https://substack.com/redirect/7234907b-678d-4e8f-aee5-d2097f72c97a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_)

**" Dallas will remove rainbow, 'Black Lives Matter' crosswalks. Here's what the community is saying"** via [Texas Public Radio](https://substack.com/redirect/c91cca7a-c254-4749-8e80-61c9303518d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - Dallas will remove 30 decorative crosswalks, including LGBTQ+ and Black Lives Matter designs, within 90 days after unsuccessfully appealing an order by the Texas Department of Transportation.

The move comes after Gov. **Greg Abbott** issued an executive order in October directing TxDOT to enforce the removal of decorative crosswalks, calling them a distraction and political.

"I wish our governor would spend time on things that actually moves the needle for our state instead of picking on vulnerable populations and low hanging fruit for political gain," Council Member **Adam Bazaldua** , who represents South Dallas, said in a statement to KERA.

TxDOT rejected Dallas' exemption request on Jan. 15, giving the city until the end of the month to make a compliance plan or face losing state and federal funding.

"While the City maintains that existing crosswalk designs do not present measurable public safety issues, we appreciate TxDOT's partnership in sustaining safe and efficient multimodal transportation within Dallas," City Manager **Kimberly Tolbert** wrote.

**" Texas primary between Crockett, Talarico turns ugly"** The Hill's **Caroline Vakil** and **Julia Mueller** - The Senate Democratic primary in Texas has taken an ugly turn, with the increased infighting threatening to complicate the party's chances of flipping the seat in November.

The most notable incident came this week when former Rep. **Colin Allred** (D-Texas), the Democratic nominee for Senate last cycle, ripped state Rep.**James Talarico**(D) for allegedly calling him a "mediocre Black man." Talarico said the allegation was a mischaracterization and that he had referred to Allred's method of campaigning as mediocre, not Allred personally.

Yet the escalating feud between Talarico and primary rival Rep. **Jasmine Crockett**(D-Texas) -- who quickly threw her support behind Allred in a statement without mentioning Talarico by name -- is rattling some Democrats, who view it as an unhelpful distraction ahead of the March 3 primary.

"We're taking our eye off the ball," Texas Democratic consultant **Joel Montfort** said. "But that this is what Democrats are very good at doing. ... We become distracted and we start infighting over things that aren't particularly beneficial to winning races."

The race for the Democratic nod for Sen. **John Cornyn 's **(R-Texas) seat has started to ramp up in recent weeks amid heated conversations around electability and polling suggesting the primary is getting tighter.

Crockett, a Black former Texas state lawmaker and civil rights attorney currently serving in the House, is seen by some as a controversial Senate candidate, given some of her online and viral exchanges, including referring to Texas Gov.**Greg Abbott**(R), who is in a wheelchair, as "hot wheels," and former Rep. **Marjorie Taylor Greene**(R-Ga.) as having a "bleach-blonde, bad-built butch body."

Last month, two comedians apologized after they said on a podcast not to support Crockett over Talarico, a white Presbyterian seminarian and former middle school teacher.

The discourse has irked some members of the party, who believe the conversation is aimed at discouraging voters from backing the Black candidate in the race.

"You're running in the Democratic primary against U.S. Rep. Jasmine Crockett and there's been a lot of discourse around her electability, and some would say that is code for they don't think a Black woman can win statewide," "The View" co-host **Sunny Hostin** told Talarico [during his appearance](https://substack.com/redirect/8687eaa2-b727-49b3-ae00-767b9d7ca8cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the show Monday.

Talarico said during that appearance he would fully back her if she became the nominee and believed she could win statewide in Texas, calling her a "friend" and saying he had "deep love and respect for her."

Meanwhile, [Punchbowl News reported](https://substack.com/redirect/5e3955aa-3a55-4415-aa68-6dab2fa12e06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) last week, citing a top Crockett supporter, that the House member's campaign is planning a rollout of attack ads targeting Talarico.

Although Crockett's team has not confirmed the reporting, Talarico responded with a statement stressing that the primary "should be a positive race" focused on their records.

The back-and-forth came just days after the Democratic rivals squared off in [their first debate](https://substack.com/redirect/ddbd53b7-007f-4428-82b4-137ea44387e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a largely cordial event that saw both sides emphasize points of agreement.

([The Hill](https://substack.com/redirect/33f967d4-b4c0-4f76-934c-081cb5e317c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))

Unlawful border crossings at the U.S.-Mexico border have plunged over the past year, as the Trump administration ramped up deportations, deployed troops and military tanks to the borderline, and prohibited migrants from seeking asylum at the border.

Construction of 500 miles of buoy barrier began in January and is part of Homeland Security's U.S. Coast Guard-led "Operation River Wall" to combat drug and human smuggling, Homeland Security Secretary **Kristi Noem** said in a Jan. 7 news conference.

From a stretch of tree-lined riverbank in Matamoros, Mexico, across the border from Brownsville, the traffic-barrel-orange barrier rests like a necklace on the wide neck of the Rio Grande. It appears to mimic Texas Gov. **Greg Abbott 's** controversial installation of a similar floating system upriver.

TOP NEWS " Thousands of Texas Public School Students Participated in Anti-ICE Protests During School Hours" Meridith Dyer - Thousands of Texas public school students participated in protests against U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement's (ICE) actions across the country on Friday, January 30. Austin Independent School District (ISD) students protesting alongside school officials and Austin ISD police officers sparked online backlash from elected officials. () " After El Paso's Medical Examiner ruled migrant's death a homicide, ICE sent the next body to an Army hospital" Colleen DeGuzman - The body of a migrant who died at an El Paso immigration detention center was sent to a military hospital rather than the county medical examiner who investigated two previous deaths at the facility -- and concluded that one of them was a homicide rather than a suicide. Victor Manuel Diaz , a 36-year-old Nicaraguan, died Jan. 14 at Camp East Montana, a massive tent facility the federal government built on the Fort Bliss Army base. According to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, Diaz was found unconscious and unresponsive in his room and died of "a presumed suicide." Diaz's autopsy is being performed at the William Beaumont Army Medical Center in Fort Bliss, which doesn't release autopsy reports to the public -- only to family members and investigators, according to Jessia Rovero, a public affairs officer at Fort Bliss. This comes after the El Paso Medical Examiner recently ruled a previous detainee's death a homicide, contradicting ICE's contention that he died by suicide. () " Dallas has worst fatal car crash rate among large cities, study finds" via - Dallas saw an average of nearly 14 fatal motor vehicle crashes annually per every 100,000 residents between 2014 and 2023, according to a recent analysis. In a joint study released last week, Drafahl Law Firm, a St. Louis-based personal injury firm, and 1Point21, a San Diego-based marketing agency, found that the fatal crash rate was the highest among large American cities. The grim data point also backs up a long-held perception that driving around Dallas is generally unpleasant -- both because of the area's bad roads, high traffic congestion, and a large contingent of motorists known for aggressive driving. At the time, a report from Forbes Advisor concluded that Dallas was tied with Atlanta as the American city where "you're most likely to get into a car accident," with Dallas drivers 46% more likely to be involved in a wreck than drivers in other parts of the country. A 2024 report from Forbes placed Dallas 6th on its "worst drivers" list, and Fort Worth in 9th place. () LOCAL GOVERNMENT " DART officials review withdrawal city proposals as special election approaches" Jacquelyn Burrer - DART officials review withdrawal city proposals as special election approaches With several cities now considering withdrawal elections, DART and city officials are discussing city proposals that could lead cities to cancel their upcoming elections. At their Jan. 27 meeting, DART officials reviewed proposals from Plano and other cities as part of ongoing talks over service levels, funding and governance. Plano officials have submitted two agreements that could lead the city to cancel its upcoming special election. Since Plano City Council voted to call the special election, nearly half of DART's 13 member cities have now scheduled withdrawal elections, including Highland Park, University Park, Irving, Farmers Branch and Addison. Since calling the special election in November, Plano officials have submitted two formal proposals to DART that could lead the city to rescinding its withdrawal election if agreed upon. Irving and Farmers Branch have also submitted written proposals to DART that are currently being evaluated. Carrollton, despite not calling a withdrawal election, submitted proposed changes to DART's general mobility program interlocal agreement. () " Dallas will remove rainbow, 'Black Lives Matter' crosswalks. Here's what the community is saying" via - Dallas will remove 30 decorative crosswalks, including LGBTQ+ and Black Lives Matter designs, within 90 days after unsuccessfully appealing an order by the Texas Department of Transportation. The move comes after Gov. Greg Abbott issued an executive order in October directing TxDOT to enforce the removal of decorative crosswalks, calling them a distraction and political. "I wish our governor would spend time on things that actually moves the needle for our state instead of picking on vulnerable populations and low hanging fruit for political gain," Council Member Adam Bazaldua , who represents South Dallas, said in a statement to KERA. TxDOT rejected Dallas' exemption request on Jan. 15, giving the city until the end of the month to make a compliance plan or face losing state and federal funding. "While the City maintains that existing crosswalk designs do not present measurable public safety issues, we appreciate TxDOT's partnership in sustaining safe and efficient multimodal transportation within Dallas," City Manager Kimberly Tolbert wrote. () 2026 " Texas primary between Crockett, Talarico turns ugly" The Hill's Caroline Vakil and Julia Mueller - The Senate Democratic primary in Texas has taken an ugly turn, with the increased infighting threatening to complicate the party's chances of flipping the seat in November. The most notable incident came this week when former Rep. Colin Allred (D-Texas), the Democratic nominee for Senate last cycle, ripped state Rep.James Talarico(D) for allegedly calling him a "mediocre Black man." Talarico said the allegation was a mischaracterization and that he had referred to Allred's method of campaigning as mediocre, not Allred personally. Yet the escalating feud between Talarico and primary rival Rep. Jasmine Crockett(D-Texas) -- who quickly threw her support behind Allred in a statement without mentioning Talarico by name -- is rattling some Democrats, who view it as an unhelpful distraction ahead of the March 3 primary. "We're taking our eye off the ball," Texas Democratic consultant Joel Montfort said. "But that this is what Democrats are very good at doing. ... We become distracted and we start infighting over things that aren't particularly beneficial to winning races." The race for the Democratic nod for Sen. John Cornyn 's (R-Texas) seat has started to ramp up in recent weeks amid heated conversations around electability and polling suggesting the primary is getting tighter. Crockett, a Black former Texas state lawmaker and civil rights attorney currently serving in the House, is seen by some as a controversial Senate candidate, given some of her online and viral exchanges, including referring to Texas Gov.Greg Abbott(R), who is in a wheelchair, as "hot wheels," and former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene(R-Ga.) as having a "bleach-blonde, bad-built butch body." Last month, two comedians apologized after they said on a podcast not to support Crockett over Talarico, a white Presbyterian seminarian and former middle school teacher. The discourse has irked some members of the party, who believe the conversation is aimed at discouraging voters from backing the Black candidate in the race. "You're running in the Democratic primary against U.S. Rep. Jasmine Crockett and there's been a lot of discourse around her electability, and some would say that is code for they don't think a Black woman can win statewide," "The View" co-host Sunny Hostin told Talarico on the show Monday. Talarico said during that appearance he would fully back her if she became the nominee and believed she could win statewide in Texas, calling her a "friend" and saying he had "deep love and respect for her." Meanwhile, last week, citing a top Crockett supporter, that the House member's campaign is planning a rollout of attack ads targeting Talarico. Although Crockett's team has not confirmed the reporting, Talarico responded with a statement stressing that the primary "should be a positive race" focused on their records. The back-and-forth came just days after the Democratic rivals squared off in , a largely cordial event that saw both sides emphasize points of agreement. () " Latest U.S. Senate Campaign Finance Reports Show Cornyn Leading in Cash on Hand, Talarico and Crockett with Strong Hauls" Mary Elise O 'Bar - End-of-year financial reports for federal campaigns are in, showing Democratic candidates in Texas' U.S. Senate race posting competitive fundraising hauls -- while incumbent U.S. Sen. John Cornyn (R-TX) remains in the lead in cash on hand (COH), followed by state Rep. James Talarico (D-Austin) and Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett (D-TX-30). Reports for federal campaigns were due on January 31, although some candidates released and touted early fundraising and COH numbers -- including Cornyn, whose campaign announced in early January that it had raised more than $7 million when including his re-election campaign numbers, the Cornyn Victory Committee, and Cornyn Lonestar Victory Fund. () " Republicans Blame Poor Turnout for Loss of Texas Senate Stronghold, Democrats Claim Win on Issues" Kim Roberts - Republicans in Tarrant County and even across the state are reeling after a strong right-leaning Texas Senate district fell to a Democrat in a special election runoff. Taylor Rehmet , a political newcomer who ran as a veteran and union leader who would "listen, show up, and get things done," defeated the well-known and longtime conservative activist Republican Leigh Wambsganss to fill the seat for Senate District (SD) 9, vacated last year by former state Sen. Kelly Hancock (R-North Richland Hills). () " Sakai makes fundraising comeback in Bexar County Judge race" Andrea Drusch - Bexar County Judge Peter Sakai made a comeback last month after being outraised by his Democratic primary challenger in the final quarter of 2025. Campaign finance data must be reported more frequently right before an election, and reports covering Jan. 1 through Jan. 22 were due Monday for state and county candidates. Peter Sakai indicated that he'd raised $176,000 in that span -- more than triple what former Mayor Ron Nirenberg raised over the same time period. Sakai spent about $200,000 and reported $483,000 on hand as of Jan. 22. By comparison, Ron Nirenberg raised $52,000 between Jan. 1 and Jan. 22, spent $86,000 and reported $347,000 on hand. Sakai's haul includes $52,000 worth of in-kind advertising from Carmen and Joe Gamez, owners of Gamez Law Firm, to sponsor billboard ads on his behalf. He also received a $75,000 contribution from the Texas Association of Realtors PAC. () TRUMP ADMINISTRATION " A 'wall' in the river: Trump's new border barrier in the Rio Grande" via - A string of orange buoys is growing in the Rio Grande, as the Trump administration builds a "river wall" to stop what is now a trickle of illegal migration. Unlawful border crossings at the U.S.-Mexico border have plunged over the past year, as the Trump administration ramped up deportations, deployed troops and military tanks to the borderline, and prohibited migrants from seeking asylum at the border. Construction of 500 miles of buoy barrier began in January and is part of Homeland Security's U.S. Coast Guard-led "Operation River Wall" to combat drug and human smuggling, Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem said in a Jan. 7 news conference. From a stretch of tree-lined riverbank in Matamoros, Mexico, across the border from Brownsville, the traffic-barrel-orange barrier rests like a necklace on the wide neck of the Rio Grande. It appears to mimic Texas Gov. Greg Abbott 's controversial installation of a similar floating system upriver. (EP TIMES) " FBI Houston Investigation Leads to Canadian National's Guilty Plea for Sexually Exploiting Over 100 Children" Mary Elise O 'Bar - A Canadian national pleaded guilty on Friday to sexually exploiting and coercing 100 minor girls by posing as an American teenage boy over social media -- a case investigated by the Houston branch of the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). Ramanan Pathmanathan 's guilty plea was made in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia, where he admitted to coercing children through video chats and his false online persona. During the calls, he would convince the minors to perform various sexual acts, recording them all-the-while, and then use it as blackmail if the children refused to continue engaging in such sexual acts. When JD Vance came to our Commonwealth to push his Administration’s talking points, he thought he could convince folks to ignore the rising prices at the grocery store and the layoffs that are a direct result of their policies.

Folks can see the progress we’ve made here at the state level — record funding for public education, hundreds of repaired bridges, and the only growing economy in the Northeast. And Derek, folks can see the chaos, cruelty, and corruption coming out of Washington on a daily basis.
Those are the two paths Pennsylvanians will see on their ballots later this year. One path that leads to progress and prosperity — and another that drags our Commonwealth backwards.
**I know which path I’m fighting for — and I know you do too.**

subject: Nothing pisses me off more than getting a fundraising email from Democrats talking about how they’re fighting fascism

Peter,
Nothing pisses me off more than getting a fundraising text from Democrats talking about how they’re fighting fascism... Because it’s such B.S. We’re not idiots. Everyone knows most of them aren’t doing jack right now to fight back.
People are being kidnapped into unmarked vans by masked police. There is a genocide happening in Palestine. Literal billionaires have taken over our government. And all Democratic leadership can do is send us another fundraising text?
My name is Graham Platner, and I’m the Marine Corps veteran and Democrat running for U.S. Senate against Susan Collins here in Maine. I’m not going to speak in platitudes or shy away from what I believe. There is a war going on in this country, and the oligarchy and the fascists are winning right now.
Susan Collins is the most vulnerable Republican senator in the country. We have an opportunity to replace her with a working-class Democrat – one who won’t take money from corporations or AIPAC.
But I’m not a wealthy guy, and we’re still short of our $50,000 goal and what we need to win. If I’m going to be able to defeat Susan Collins and flip this Senate seat blue, I need folks like you to chip in now to my campaign.
Please, will you split a donation right now between my campaign and The Real Texas PAC to help me defeat Susan Collins, flip Maine blue, and take back the Senate with a Democrat who will actually fight to defend our democracy like Democrats oughta be? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-platner?refcode=012126_1]

In the history of this nation, power has never been just willingly handed to the people. Another mealy-mouthed Democrat isn’t going to fix things or protect our constitution.
I’m ready to go to the United States Senate and fight – but I need your help today to get there. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-platner?refcode=012126_1]
In solidarity,
Graham Platner

Peter,
This week, Democrats in the Maryland state House of Representatives passed a new Congressional map that would give Democrats an additional seat in Congress.
The new map now moves to the Maryland state Senate where it must also be approved.
But unfortunately, it's looking like their effort to counter MAGA's is flatlining:

This is catastrophic news for Democrats.
The redistricting arms race has become a full-on sprint, and the math currently favors MAGA. They need to pick up 18 additional seats to fully lock Democrats out of Congress, and they have a clear path to reaching that number.
Every single seat matters for Democrats at this point to stop MAGA election rigging. If MD's effort collapses, Democrats will be in dire straits.
But thankfully, Colorado is providing Democrats with life support.
Colorado Draws the Line is spearheading a ballot initiative that would give Democrats 3-4 additional seats in Congress in Colorado. If Maryland's effort is officially pronounced dead, we could be the difference in this existential fight for Democrats.
But MAGA knows this as well, and they are gearing up to spend millions to defeat us before the initiative even makes it on the ballot. If Democrats from across the country rally to our cause right now, we will defeat them.
[Please, will you rush a contribution of $25, $15, or whatever you can spare to our ballot measure committee and help us get new maps on the ballot for Colorado? Our average donation is around $30. name: Cliff Schecter with Blue Amp
subject: What we need to keep BAM growing (straight talk)
body:
We need to hire a producer and a video editor to launch our new shows. Here's why.

| |
---|---|---
|
# What we need to keep BAM growing (straight talk)
### We need to hire a producer and a video editor to launch our new shows. Here's why.
| | | [Cliff Schecter](https://substack.com/@cliffsedge) and [Blue Amp Media](https://substack.com/@blueamp)
---
| Feb 4
---
| [](https://substack.com/@cliffsedge)| | [](https://substack.com/@blueamp)
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ccd76e29-9d2c-4619-ac49-82cc55ac7d56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Hi--
I want to be very clear and very practical with you.
We're launching **three new shows** at Blue Amp Media. To do that _well_ --not sloppily, not on fumes--we need to **hire a producer and a video editor**.
That's it. That's the ask.
[Help us grow and save 50%!](https://substack.com/redirect/ccd76e29-9d2c-4619-ac49-82cc55ac7d56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Right now, BAM is run **exceptionally lean**. Most of the work you see--writing, booking, producing, editing, publishing--is being done by a _very small team wearing too many hats_. We've pushed it as far as we can without burning people out or lowering the quality you expect.
A producer means:
* shows run on time
* guests are booked and prepped
* hosts can focus on content, not logistics

A video editor means:
* faster turnaround
* better clips
* more reach for the work we're already doing

This is not about growth for growth's sake.
It's about doing this **the right way** , because this is what we believe in.
That's why we're running the **[BAM Next Level Pledge Drive](https://substack.com/redirect/ccd76e29-9d2c-4619-ac49-82cc55ac7d56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** right now. For a limited time, we're offering **[50% off monthly and annual subscriptions](https://substack.com/redirect/ccd76e29-9d2c-4619-ac49-82cc55ac7d56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. Every new paid subscription directly helps fund these two roles.
Here's what we're launching:
* _**CounterStory Perspectives**_**with Melissa Corrigan** -- Mondays at 2pm ET
_Melissa is digging into tough topics and auditing the narrative of this political moment. Don 't miss her first show on Christian Nationalism with Tim Whitaker._
* _**Deep Dive with Ellie Leonard**_ -- Fridays at 2pm ET
_Ellie will be diving deep into her work as a citizen journalist --and how you can do the same kind of work she does, using whatever your best skills are._
* _**Tequila Talk**_**with Joe Walsh & Cliff Schecter** -- Thursdays at 6pm ET
_Absolutely unmissable --two former political opponents, united by their hatred of fascism and their love of tequila. How could you not watch this?!_

If BAM has been useful to you--if it's helped you understand this moment, stay engaged, or feel less alone--this is the moment when support really matters.
[Those shows look amazing! I'm in!](https://substack.com/redirect/ccd76e29-9d2c-4619-ac49-82cc55ac7d56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The pledge drive runs through **Friday, Feb 13 at 11:59pm ET**.
👉 **[Subscribe now and help us hire the producer and editor these shows need](https://substack.com/redirect/ccd76e29-9d2c-4619-ac49-82cc55ac7d56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Thanks for being here. We don't take your support lightly--and we don't do this work without it.
--Cliff
(C) 2026 Cliff Schecter
PO Box 8384, Cincinnati, OH 45208

Dear Supporter,
We have big news and an urgent message.
A Michigan news outlet [reported](https://michcov.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=12ae025e5876fdceb812e1ab0&id=e0a09bfaa7&e=ecf60db114) that our effort to secure a citizenship and voter ID question on the Michigan ballot is moving forward. The article notes that our petition drive has reportedly reached the number of signatures needed to qualify for the November ballot, 446,198 valid signatures, and that we are continuing to collect more before we submit them for validation later this month.
This is a huge step forward and it shows the strength and momentum of this campaign. But here is the bottom line.
We are not finished.
We must get these petitions in now.
We have half a million pieces of mail hitting mailboxes across Michigan right now, carrying petitions and information that will help us secure tens of thousands more signatures. But none of that matters if the petitions are not returned.
Here is what you need to do:
* Return your signed petition immediately. Do not wait.
* Encourage every supporter you know to send theirs back as soon as possible.
* Mail or drop off petitions so they arrive well before our submission deadline this month.

Yes, we have collected a strong number of signatures so far. And yes, we are still collecting until the deadline before we submit to the state. Every additional valid signature strengthens our position and improves our chances of success.
_We are close, but we are not at the finish line yet. This campaign only succeeds if everyone follows through._
Thank you for everything you have done so far. Now let’s finish strong.
In partnership for secure elections,
Citizen Only Voting Michigan
P.S. We would love for you to consider donating to this cause. If you can spare $5, $10, $100 or more, every dollar gets us one step closer to our goal.

I'm starting this month the same way I’ve been trying to start each day lately — by remembering what I'm grateful for. I’m grateful for this incredible community of supporters who refuse to give up, even when things are heavy. And I’m deeply grateful for the more than 50,000 grassroots donors who have stood with JanePAC, giving what they could as we work to elect brave leaders across the country who will stand up to Trump’s cruelty and lead with people like you at the center of their hearts and their policies. But today, I'm not writing to ask for money. **I'm writing because I genuinely want to check in and see how you’re taking care of yourself right now.** This is one of those moments when it feels like every time we try to move forward, something deeply personal or terrifying finds us. Trump’s authoritarian agenda is accelerating. Communities are under attack. Freedoms are being stripped away. If you’re feeling angry, anxious, or overwhelmed — you’re not alone. I feel it too. I'm 88, and this is the most frightening period I've lived through. But one thing I’ve learned over time is that we can’t keep giving if we’re completely drained. **If we’re going to stay in this fight for the long haul, we have to take care of ourselves along the way.** For me, that means staying physically active. I still do my workouts every single day because it keeps me grounded. It also means staying engaged through my free speech initiative my father started during the McCarthy era that we brought back last year — where we're training people to defend our constitutional rights, and that gives me hope. But your self-care might look completely different than mine, and that’s okay. There’s no right or wrong way to get through moments like this. **[If you have a few minutes, I'd really love to hear from you. Will you share what you're doing to take care of yourself right now? Every response I read reminds me that we're not alone in this, and that means everything.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124731390/599523796/-1504811813?refcode=ea.2a09d998-0602-f111-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ms=ea.2a09d998-0602-f111-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJhMDlkOTk4LTA2MDItZjExMS04MzJmLTAwMGQzYTFmMGU0YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ef0LWWtfRMLX_d9UPmC39W04zVxL7vpkdzPDyA6YQaM=&emci=5ecfe690-0602-f111-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&emdi=2a09d998-0602-f111-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ceid=4823105)** | [MESSAGE JANE →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124731391/599523797/-1504811813?refcode=ea.2a09d998-0602-f111-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ms=ea.2a09d998-0602-f111-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJhMDlkOTk4LTA2MDItZjExMS04MzJmLTAwMGQzYTFmMGU0YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ef0LWWtfRMLX_d9UPmC39W04zVxL7vpkdzPDyA6YQaM=&emci=5ecfe690-0602-f111-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&emdi=2a09d998-0602-f111-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ceid=4823105)

| | | | | | Dear Peter,

With the filing deadline quickly approaching, we now have at least one opponent in this race.
[I could really use your help to show strength as the field gets set.](https://us.list-manage.com/ZE1sQtBIpEU?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba)
Our now public fundraising numbers showed a strong start, but this final term is anything but assured.
Activists from all directions — whether NIMBYs upset about my push to build workforce housing on district land, anti-public school groups, or political extremists on either end of the spectrum whose agendas have nothing to do with supporting our students — are looking to exploit this moment. I need your help to make clear that this district still values steady, problem-solving leadership.
In a political climate defined by a free-for-all governor’s race and chaos in city government, people are trying to push radical agendas onto the ballot. I want to show early, undeniable strength that says this district believes in results, not noise.
If you’re able, please consider giving $100 — or whatever you can — today to help us show momentum before the ballot is finalized.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: The Constitution is on our side
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Our democracy has been passed on to us, from generation to generation, for 250 years. That legacy is more than just tradition. These are our rights as Americans.
#

Team, I vowed to do everything I could to stand up to Pete Hegseth. So, I sued him.
I made my case in federal court yesterday. I didn't just do it for my Constitutional rights, but for millions of retired veterans and all Americans. There is nothing more fundamental to our Democracy than the freedom to speak out about our government – that’s what I’m fighting for.
Given what’s at stake, I appreciate the judge’s careful consideration in this lawsuit.
I joined the Navy and ran for the Senate to defend this country and our Constitution.
Secretary Hegseth has censured me and is trying to demote me for things I said. For doing my job as a Senator.
This isn’t happening in isolation. Since taking office, this Administration has used its power to go after the First Amendment rights of all Americans. That goal flies in the fact of everything the United States was founded upon.
But we have something they don’t: The Constitution and the law are on our side.
Our democracy has been passed down to us, from generation to generation, for 250 years. That legacy is more than just tradition. It is woven into the fabric of our nation.
I do not intend to allow one president to tear that apart.
Don’t give up the ship.
-Mark

Mark Kelly will always fight for what he believes in, but this is different than anything he has ever faced. He has the full weight of the executive branch bearing down on him.

| Good afternoon Friend,
Education freedom is not a distant policy debate — it’s unfolding in real time in Mississippi. While school choice legislation did not advance in the Senate this week, the conversation around education freedom is far from over. In many ways, this moment makes our upcoming **Education Freedom** luncheon on **February 10** even more timely — offering space to unpack what happened, why it stalled, and what comes next. We’re honored to welcome **Corey DeAngelis** , one of the nation’s most influential voices on school choice. Corey has worked in states across the country where education reform efforts initially failed, only to return stronger and more successful in future sessions. His perspective on how reform movements navigate resistance — and ultimately succeed — brings critical context to Mississippi’s current moment. This conversation will also feature Mississippi leaders who are advancing education freedom on the ground and understand the realities of policy change in our state:
* **Starla Brown** , State Director of Americans for Prosperity Mississippi, leading grassroots efforts to turn ideas into action
* **Lindsey Beckham** , State Chair and Legislative Chair for Moms for Liberty, elevating parent voices across Mississippi
* **Leah Ferretti** , Director of Mississippi Ready, focused on expanding education options for Mississippi families

Join the people of Missouri who are fighting back against an extreme gerrymander

---

Peter,
The redistricting crisis across the country is fueling widespread turmoil, just nine months before the midterm elections. Nowhere is that more true than in Missouri.
It all started last year when the state legislature redrew their map to pass an egregious gerrymander as part of a power grab by politicians in D.C. Since then, the people of Missouri have fought back to ensure their voice is heard — and have been contending with dirty tricks from anti-democracy forces at every turn.
After citizens quickly gathered 300,000 signatures to place the map on the ballot for a statewide referendum, state officials moved to strike nearly one-third of the signatures. Then, when it was clear the initiative would likely move forward regardless of those efforts, the Secretary of State proposed highly biased ballot language — a tactic he has used for other issues he doesn’t approve of, such as abortion rights.
If that wasn’t enough, outside groups have been targeting voters with threatening text messages that told voters to remove their names from the petition “before it’s too late,” and spending $2.9 million on efforts to try to stop the citizen-led ballot initiative.
Such a blatant assault on direct democracy is hard to contend with. But Missourians aren’t giving up the fight, and neither will we.

clean_body: Join the people of Missouri who are fighting back against an extreme gerrymander | Peter, The redistricting crisis across the country is fueling widespread turmoil, just nine months before the midterm elections. Nowhere is that more true than in Missouri. It all started last year when the state legislature redrew their map to pass an egregious gerrymander as part of a power grab by politicians in D.C. Since then, the people of Missouri have fought back to ensure their voice is heard — and have been contending with dirty tricks from anti-democracy forces at every turn. After citizens quickly gathered 300,000 signatures to place the map on the ballot for a statewide referendum, state officials moved to strike nearly one-third of the signatures. Then, when it was clear the initiative would likely move forward regardless of those efforts, the Secretary of State proposed highly biased ballot language — a tactic he has used for other issues he doesn’t approve of, such as abortion rights. If that wasn’t enough, outside groups have been targeting voters with threatening text messages that told voters to remove their names from the petition “before it’s too late,” and spending $2.9 million on efforts to try to stop the citizen-led ballot initiative. Such a blatant assault on direct democracy is hard to contend with. Friends,
This is an all-hands-on-deck moment.
As the Trump administration escalates aggressive immigration enforcement across the country, too many public officials are looking the other way. New Yorkers deserve transparency, accountability, and leadership that puts human dignity first.
[**Can you chip in $5 today to help us fight back?**](https://us.list-manage.com/rtM2VzEVbwo?e=5702859c35&c2id=d81f0eeb8df9a762172d9a6d0e35641a)
As New York State Comptroller, I’ve pledged to use every tool of the office to ensure public dollars are not used to intimidate workers, tear apart families, or enable abuse.
Here’s what that means:
**Holding ICE enablers accountable**
The Comptroller has authority to audit how federal law-enforcement grants flow through New York. I will scrutinize jurisdictions operating under 287(g) agreements and examine local officials who voluntarily cooperate with ICE and CBP.
That includes officials like Nassau County Executive Bruce Blakeman, who has aligned his administration with federal immigration enforcement. If public funds are being misused or safeguards violated, those findings will be made public and referred to the appropriate authorities.
This campaign is about making sure New York’s finances reflect New York’s values.
[**If you believe public money should be used to protect communities — not harm them — I hope you’ll chip in $5 today and stand with us.**](https://us.list-manage.com/vbRoCLAw897?e=5702859c35&c2id=d81f0eeb8df9a762172d9a6d0e35641a)

Peter,

I wanted to take a moment to say **thank you.**

Because of you, we hit our end-of-month fundraising goal for January!

And it didn't just happen overnight or by accident— _it happened because people like you decided that showing up still matters, even when life is busy and the news is overwhelming._

But before we explain, we need to ask you something directly. | | If you’ve saved your payment info with ActBlue, your contribution will be processed immediately. | | ---|--- | | Outside groups have spent over two million dollars to influence this primary — more than the Republicans ever spent running against Mikie Sherrill or any Democrat in the 11th District in an entire two-year campaign cycle. Not because they care about NJ-11, and not because voters here asked for it, but because they want to send a message to Democrats across the country to fall in line or else. Tom Malinowski has never taken corporate PAC money. He’s pushed for tougher ethics rules, fought corruption, and taken principled stands that powerful interests oppose. That independence is exactly why these groups are trying to distort his record and flood the airwaves at the last minute. This is what happens when a campaign has real momentum and when the candidate leading the race can’t be bought. The stakes here go beyond one primary. If these tactics work, they’ll be used again and again against candidates who won’t play along. That’s why it matters that we stand up to them now. While other politicians hem and haw about today’s most pressing issues, Abdul has been clear about where he stands: He’s fighting to pass Medicare for All and guarantee healthcare for all Americans, so that working people never have to sacrifice getting the care they need. He’s calling for ICE to be abolished and to rebuild immigration enforcement from the ground up. He’s focused on building an economy that uplifts working people by empowering unions and expanding wage protections. And, he’s running a campaign that rejects corporate PAC and AIPAC money. Those aren’t always viewed as “safe” positions in D.C., but they’re the ones that’ll actually make a positive impact. That undoubtedly puts a big target on our campaign. Corporate PACs and AIPAC are already funneling cash into Michigan to protect the status quo. The only way we counter that is with a grassroots movement strong enough to stand up to it. Peter,

In less than two weeks, millions of people will gather to watch the biggest football game of the year. **Bright lights.**
**Packed hotels.** **Most people don't know this...** Wherever crowds gather, traffickers follow. Major sporting weekends bring increased travel, full hotels, busy airports, and distracted attention. **Behind the excitement ...**
**Children will go missing.** This is the perfect environment for exploitation. Law enforcement and child protection organizations know this pattern well. **Trafficking spikes around large events because vulnerability increases. **While millions are preparing for entertainment, vulnerable children are facing danger. They're not thinking about scores or highlights, but hoping to be safe - waiting for help before harm happens. This is why this moment matters. Here is a truth that should stop us cold: **9 out of 10 missing children are trafficked right here in the United States.** That's why I'm reaching out to you today. The**Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists to interrupt these moments of danger with protection, prevention, and action. We are not here for awareness alone.Awareness without action does not save a child. We are here to stop trafficking before it starts, support intervention efforts, and protect children when the risk is highest. **But this mission is not an idea. ****It is personal. **
**It is lived. **
**It is carried by those who know danger firsthand.**
---
[ **Save a Child. Give Now**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e183440179ad460fa403b3bc70987fef&_e=l0iiJfL8oKN1wbEwKhdulv8W75OGUjGwUGFs5zYNqRxjWdBgoGzd_K2SdvXFtB7aJEx4YQsieH5NczECutZ5yTnzVw0sHoMVces67htq2RGLrsFzpGw7aiYgLix6huTqtCsFaTNymeTY2oR-MVq4u6LIrV5EzDTaOmgzUruUefuV_XMq34LSRq8AW5CBlzD0rhVmj7zb_W7kH81WlblpwJ4lXtnqA0whAzjWcGi8pkUceaAurzJIjZ7-TElN2wt0Z9DkCLFpvKA0-nTw4bDod6ce5s1bT-vkmD0f9tozq2U5YGpvAHiaUGoW7z6L5MQYOlht0FMzS7HrxfiTd5K7A8iP-eGHyTKmzCUyQGy8DE6DYF_8l4b-98sfbTTL3YbMz840Cm4NcGnGNKLIKKyGNLWtXvH6m1vX37a77rw_vz6YcVYmZzymuse7DbXvGwBdGB6PG-YOk2bwj_lfhjj-YBkwiL_IzRsqPZSg6TeiBhOOEepr-KA4Zsm-wLsfpdFxx8bxM3cE3WB0UMb7czdk1suNGeWa06XnYp5trnZ3QLd42c-9i1srtA3IHexlBcX3uWOewPrK19edl53awi97kH4zHiv82k3O8wVvML5zpxGMu0byaOFbo4ZgGNVjOofXi2FurXBFFZnTcEmXNAP7yt-ER62tgnjqUR7baK6F2CdfTt9NqXYOwqdmwfYs_WVb1HEksfc-Ey-OajJ-DFJbHpH-9MkZgUHy8tPgldQYUGOG65tS3NnrQUUCUd8ykHUW)
---
My name is Theresa Flores. I'm a survivor of child trafficking. And today, I work to help protect children **before they disappear.** **I was fifteen years old. **
**An honor student. **
**A daughter. ** A girl who trusted the wrong "friend." **I was trafficked for two years.**

Most people imagine trafficking happens far away...in dark alleys...in other countries.

To "other people." **But that's not how it usually happens.** Right now, as set up for the big game is underway, **120 trained partner volunteers are already on the ground in the Bay Area**. Men and women working _this week_ --
Training hotel staff to recognize danger. Walking hotel halls, parking garages and public spaces. **Watching.**
**Reporting.**
**Protecting.** **Standing where traffickers don't expect resistance.** Children cannot choose safety on their own. They depend on adults to act when danger is highest. Freedom is not a word painted in an end zone. It's safety, dignity and the chance to grow up without fear. Your donation right now helps fund prevention programs, strengthen intervention efforts, and protect innocent lives from trafficking and abuse.It turns high-risk moments into moments of defense and hope.
---
[ **Save a Child. Give Now**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e183440179ad460fa403b3bc70987fef&_e=l0iiJfL8oKN1wbEwKhdulv8W75OGUjGwUGFs5zYNqRxjWdBgoGzd_K2SdvXFtB7aJEx4YQsieH5NczECutZ5yTnzVw0sHoMVces67htq2RGLrsFzpGw7aiYgLix6huTqtCsFaTNymeTY2oR-MVq4u6LIrV5EzDTaOmgzUruUefuV_XMq34LSRq8AW5CBlzD0rhVmj7zb_W7kH81WlblpwJ4lXtnqA0whAzjWcGi8pkUceaAurzJIjZ7-TElN2wt0Z9DkCLFpvKA0-nTw4bDodxpUz9a5BHARzVLKen3wAMgOoQtr4SxLgPvQE1X9YHhXw6mNXzr3cGCo0xzzHrbZ2uxVmtZhb9jxky4-e6Tg-J9XSuORI8NMD43FJ-XBj78U722D39fpKLi_M5LUi_zB7PxUyElZyRVzxiB7lRyfqY1dCmLQegemxB7jj3IcuNMFWjqTy0j9_UT4YF_B0QZhPKKOQEOlMuDgyPOJtZuIshT_dSd4kdhesWXuzbzUJmIHAlvlZ7kabNuJMOmbXwC3nxCCm3J2ax1RemwXERk8adYCczJTlLa4RKa6zie5vDbQXh6sK7O4GH5GOdqWAWzN7UCwaCnH07LiNenzFWZ3r0kzRJndp5BfbppBusJaF6UV3buHq_jHCCp6p7_mkF8ztR1yjZq0EAIdVXZ1-WF0z5Fhlb3G2oDXzqmqA8fF3YDFkbVY6Ql7s-bq3WHONIweecySmmlYU8-Plg7ZII7XV8I6FiVPHLlTv-W0ZZ7e-7H_)

**The game will last a few hours. **
**Your impact lasts a lifetime. **Your generosity will create awareness and help ordinary people recognize danger before another child is harmed.While millions will be watching, traffickers will be working. But so will our partners. **And with your help, we can be faster and more effective in protecting children who need us most. **We will place **30,000 soap packets** into hotel rooms--each one printed with a missing child hotline number.
---

---
That number has saved lives. Because sometimes, the only moment a child is truly alone...
is in the bathroom. **This is what rescue looks like ****_before_**** a headline or a news story.** Right now, I'm asking you to do something just as important as giving. **Please pray that they'll be found.** **Pray for the children whose names we don't know yet.**
**Pray for the ones who are afraid to speak.**
**Pray for courage, protection, and rescue.** Jesus said, _" Let the little children come to me... and do not hinder them."_ This is how we don't hinder them.
**This is how we show up.** This is your moment to step onto the field for freedom.
This is your chance to make the play that changes a child's future. If you feel led to take the next step, here's how your gift helps protect children during this dangerous week:
---
* **$60** helps equip one trained volunteer
* **$120** strengthens outreach and training materials
* **$180** expands protection across multiple hotel locations
* **$240** multiplies our presence when traffickers are most active

---
Traffickers are already preparing. But so are we. **Because of people like you.**
**Because of prayer.** **God 's children are not for sale.** For God's Children,

What we saw confirmed why oversight matters and why silence is not an option when federal power is exercised without transparency or accountability. | = | Hi Peter, I wanted to follow up with you after a deeply troubling few days. This weekend, my team and I went inside the ICE facility in Baltimore after alarming reports about conditions for people being held there. What we saw confirmed why oversight matters and why silence is not an option when federal power is exercised without transparency or accountability. At the same time, we learned that ICE quietly purchased a warehouse in Washington County to build a new detention facility without community input or public disclosure. Last week, I stood with hundreds of Marylanders to send a clear message to the Trump Administration: our communities will not be steamrolled, and our neighbors will not be targeted in silence. Let me be clear. Planning detention facilities behind closed doors is not governance. It is intimidation. And I will not accept it. I will continue to demand answers, conduct oversight, and stand with Marylanders who believe our government must be transparent, accountable, and humane. This work is not easy, and it is not popular with those who benefit from secrecy. But it is necessary. = | | | = | = | = | = | = Thank you for standing with me and for caring about what happens when power is exercised without restraint. | We cannot let Stephen Miller continue with this vile agenda.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9502%2E5257348%2Ej8oJe4)
Team, There are a lot of dangerous people serving in the Trump Administration. MAGA loyalists who will put Donald Trump’s needs above our country’s. But no one is worse than Stephen Miller, an unelected white nationalist who has accumulated an _immense amount of power_ in the Trump administration. Stephen Miller has been a bigot for his whole career — working on anti-immigration legislation and supporting right-wing hate groups before becoming a part of Donald Trump’s first presidential campaign. He’s the architect of some of the worst and most hateful policies of the Trump Administration. Some of the people closest to the president, like Steve Bannon, refer to Stephen Miller as the Prime Minister. Others, like Kevin McCarthy, call him Trump's brain. Regardless of his nicknames, he has had a significant influence on Donald Trump in the most draconian of ways. In just the first Trump administration: You can credit Miller with the Muslim travel ban.
You can credit him with the family separation policy that took kids away from their parents and put them in cages.
You can credit him with trying to do away with DACA. After Trump lost the 2020 election, Stephen Miller filed lawsuits trying to overturn the election result. And for Trump 2.0, Stephen Miller has somehow become _even more extreme._ He’s drafting Trump’s immigration policies. He’s “protecting his friends and going after the bad guys,” in his own words. And in his world, his friends are people who look like him — straight, white men. Anyone else — women, members of the LGBTQ+ community, Black Americans, Latinos, and beyond — well, sorry, but Stephen Miller doesn’t care about your rights and freedoms. The latest, and perhaps most egregious, of Miller’s policies is his effort to invoke the _Insurrection Act_. This would allow the President to order the military to basically police our streets — arresting people, enforcing the law, basically putting us under martial law. **We cannot let Stephen Miller continue with this vile agenda.** We have to continue and intensify what we've been doing — not just here in Congress as we fight to overhaul ICE. We need to protest, support our neighbors, and capture the administration’s lawlessness on video to show the country and the world what’s happening. And we must demand accountability. _And come November, after the elections, there needs to be accountability._ Thanks for reading this long email about Trump’s bigot-in-chief. We have to know who is calling the shots behind the scenes and, more importantly, do all we can to stop him. More soon, Adam | [DONATE](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/5643?c0=q12026_abs_em.MBJc12&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20260204_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=9502%2E5257348%2Ej8oJe4)

| | | **“The FBI raid at the Fulton County elections office should alarm us all.”**
—Stacey Abrams
---
I co-founded Fair Fight after significant large-scale voter difficulties in Georgia’s 2018 election.
And I had one fundamental mission in mind: to help make sure every eligible voter can register to vote, cast their ballot, and have it counted.
We got to work tackling voter suppression. We helped make sure people were ready and able to make their voices heard at the ballot box. And in 2020, Georgia voters awarded our state’s electoral votes to Joe Biden — the first time a Democratic presidential candidate had won here in nearly 30 years.
Donald Trump has yet to forgive the people of Georgia for handing him that defeat.
He and his extremist enablers have continued to spread lies about the results and spew conspiracy theories focused on Fulton County, Georgia. **And just last week, the FBI carried out a raid at a Fulton County elections office, seizing hundreds of boxes of election-related materials from the 2020 cycle.**
That should set off alarm bells for all of us in this moment.
Fulton County is the most populous in Georgia, home to roughly a million people, the majority of them Black, Latino, Asian, and immigrant. It is a backbone of Democratic participation in the state. The Trump Regime seizing the 2020 voter file along with ballots is very concerning. And Trump directly engaging with the FBI agents shows this is a personal vendetta and that he is willing to violate any and all norms to attempt to suppress votes and control elections. **If you were looking for a single dataset that could be misused to intimidate, challenge, or preemptively disqualify voters at scale, this would be it.**
[**This news makes it even more critical to make sure the will of the people can still be heard. The team at Fair Fight continues to defend the basic American principle of free and fair elections in Georgia, throughout the South, and around the country. They need our support in this moment of rising autocracy. The FBI raid comes as the Trump Regime faces an array of political setbacks — including intense backlash to their ICE raids and violence.
If they do not believe their Republican Party can win free and fair elections, they appear ready to try to silence the will of the people.
That is how you hollow out a democracy.
In Step 10 of the 10 Steps to Autocracy and Authoritarianism that I have laid out, people are still allowed to show up and cast ballots, but decisions will already have been made long before Election Day — about who is allowed to register, whose eligibility is challenged, whose presence is considered suspicious, whose vote is counted, and whose is quietly discarded.
It’s the difference between the right to vote and the ability to vote.
Once that line is crossed, elections can remain technically “free” while no longer being fair — because the outcomes are shaped in advance, and the test is graded before anyone is allowed to take it.
**There is still time to stop American autocracy, but not much. Organizations like Fair Fight will continue to need our support so they can ensure elections that are truly free and actually fair.**

Stacey

This is an all-hands-on-deck moment: President Trump just said Republicans should “nationalize” elections and put Republicans in charge of state elections.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260204em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260204em]
Let’s be clear about what that means.
It means placing the administration of our elections under the personal control of a President who has already tried to overturn one election. And it means ripping up our Constitution because our wannabe dictator doesn’t like the results of an election he clearly lost. And it’s a clear signal he’s afraid of losing more elections and the accountability that will follow.
I won’t allow that to happen in Oregon.
States run elections. Not presidents. And as Oregon’s Secretary of State, I take that responsibility seriously — because democracy doesn’t defend itself.
We’ve beaten Trump-backed efforts in court before. We’ve already stopped him from forcing Oregon to give his Department of Justice access to your private voter data. And if he tries again, we’ll fight him again — and win again.
So here’s the bottom line: Trump can bluster on right-wing podcasts and cable news all he wants. He can threaten, lie, cheat, and moan about all the elections he’s lost.
But in Oregon, the rules still matter. The Constitution still matters. And intimidation will always fail.
I can’t do this alone, though. Taking on President Donald Trump and winning requires a strong grassroots network, so I’m asking you to stand with me and add your name to my petition today. Tell President Trump and anyone who enables him: Oregon’s elections are not yours to take. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/NrgrO3JQx0qx2yXRXfjF1A2]
ADD YOUR NAME [https://secure.ngpvan.com/NrgrO3JQx0qx2yXRXfjF1A2]
This isn’t about party allegiance. This is about whether we let a would-be dictator decide who gets to vote and who wins elections.
I know where I stand. I’m counting on you to be there with me.
Thank you,
Tobias Read

Friend, Corporations are enabling ICE’s violence against our communities. Around the country, people are pressuring corporate collaborators to break ties with ICE. The movement has pushed companies to stop running deportation flights, stop renting rooms to federal immigration agents, and stop airing recruitment ads for ICE.1 Let’s keep going. Major corporations profiting off and enabling ICE terror include: **Amazon** ’s cloud services power ICE data and surveillance operations. **AT &T; and Verizon** provide communications infrastructure and data analytics for ICE. They each have contracts worth over $140 million with ICE. **Google and its subsidiary YouTube** are running vile, racist ICE recruitment ads on their platforms. Google also hosts a CBP app that identifies and targets immigrants using facial recognition. Meanwhile, Google removed community-created ICE-tracking apps from its store. **Home Depot** has allowed ICE to use its parking lots and stores for its violent kidnapping operations. The company uses AI license plate readers to share our data with surveillance systems used by police and ICE. **Microsoft** sells technology to the Department of Homeland Security and holds direct and indirect contracts with ICE. It provides software as well as IT and cloud services for mass surveillance and illegal abductions, and it suppresses employee protests that call out its complicity. **Palantir** ―owned by billionaire Peter Thiel―provides analytics tools and databases that support ICE targeting and surveillance. **Corporations are susceptible to public pressure campaigns, and they need to keep hearing from us.** [**Click here to send a message to the CEOs and executives leading these corporations, demanding they immediately end their contracts with ICE and stop profiting off of ICE violence.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38l3-YgbzAhwPcDqj-nes1m0bzoiQvl0dtDoTGiH80YvSeoOCQfAjP3wV9TtHi5bRYdZxmmaJ5qUyodiB956J0l_4HQ4njdelFRJldfGGcuk7CNp-eaPQTGdnikHrrmxTFL5-wewulkOSGDptjrY7_o5x-dhhVRHHnwEoodAgW3ibjDtDCok8mQvkOs0LlbLCT49r1QO-GEMYOGJcQwNayvGutFykM_e0BLryg_fLXXTwQihr9drdj7AObcMhvPZ8xCwO_TNXcbOugtGll2nZtMrHCD11Qrv_vucwqJf_LkhdkPXT8sYsgYNpn5t2F1RjIQbplkCjDIX3EeDrfD9pbJlla1uGaouDPMWEuSEVrIWJBRImCP9YxlERjg9h5H7BM/4nv/8LE-egptTt6CgLGuZ97o8g/h1/h001.kyghaG95_o3YoZSB5UD8sr12xlQt4CpygBuESN3BxTg) | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38l3-YgbzAhwPcDqj-nes1m0bzoiQvl0dtDoTGiH80YvSeoOCQfAjP3wV9TtHi5bRYdZxmmaJ5qUyodiB956J0lPv4K6nDiEBG7laUYX8_neoCH5OgNKSL1iUZK3vPX_9ToF3zUHnfNARgLyLIwPC99DBI4AL8PhCK5aFtTZbbQ0l_RC5qgK09oqQCVTAa82lnqydFpRtpzfFbL4EIsbXirUZvoB4SSFWgKXoil29SKPLK2P1ssRpWd8_T7xPePCVD6uRrl6Nn29U9bnNeQ8iFcRqRJ1cScXScyRUbBX_LAgK4mZ0grgLWV_8L8sQ19xIG7a-zS4z7Jw1sX3TGuXyYDb0pXYZ0A5rSaQK477j2qou8cNLWeiEve-9w2OGQUpKU/4nv/8LE-egptTt6CgLGuZ97o8g/h2/h001.GAYWTHao3klGhyvZ8HTax1Cbk1s_J3jm1ZMtqQqiHk0)

One of Minnesota’s largest employers, **Target** has been conspicuously silent on ICE violence across the state—simply calling to “de-escalate tensions” without even mentioning ICE, the murders of Renee Good or Alex Pretti, or ICE attacks on its own employees.
As our immigrant neighbors are forced into hiding and ICE kidnaps and locks up our neighbors, one of the ways we can protect each other and weaken ICE is by demanding corporations refuse to cooperate with ICE.
